name: csp_lint
description: Lint a Content-Security-Policy header value with CSP Level 3 semantics and the checks of Google's CSP Evaluator: unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval in scripts, wildcards, http:, https: and data: sources, missing object-src, base-uri, script-src, default-src and frame-ancestors, known allowlist-bypass hosts, short nonces, strict-dynamic and nonce/hash interplay, deprecated, unknown and misspelt directives, missing semicolons, reporting and report-only or meta delivery notes. Each finding has a severity and a fix.

policy.description: The header value; a leading 'Content-Security-Policy:' is ignored; commas separate policies

catalog.source: W3C Content Security Policy Level 3; checks after Google's CSP Evaluator (google/csp-evaluator, Apache-2.0) and Weichselbaum et al., CSP Is Dead, Long Live CSP! (ACM CCS 2016)
